name: Templates
description: Insert a note from your Templates folder at the cursor, with {{date}}, {{time}}, {{title}}, {{selection}} and Hebrew weekdays filled in. Like Templater, without running code.
author: Lumen

capabilities.reason: Reads the notes in your Templates folder
Uses the note’s name for {{title}} and the selection for {{selection}}
Inserts the filled template at the cursor
Lets you choose a template when there are several
Remembers which folder holds your templates
